europe_now.title: Russian strike risks for allies
europe_now.summary: Donald Tusk warned that Ukraine's allies face a risk of accidental Russian strikes during the fall and winter. The warning underscores the ongoing security concerns across the region.

sources.headline: Tusk warns of ‘accidental’ Russian strikes against Ukraine’s allies in fall and winter

europe_now.title: Romanian political crisis response
europe_now.summary: The Romanian president has proposed European Union lawmaker Siegfried Mureșan to lead the country out of its current political crisis. Mureșan was tapped to help stabilize the government leadership.

sources.headline: Romanian president taps EU lawmaker Mureșan to lead country out of crisis

top_stories.title: Ukraine conflict and security
top_stories.summary: Donald Tusk warned of accidental Russian strikes against Ukraine's allies in the fall and winter. Meanwhile, Ukrainian leadership made changes following a corruption scandal.
